title: SEC3: duplicate validate_blob_id in kith-chat
description: kith-chat/src/message.rs contains a local fn validate_blob_id that mirrors BlobStore::validate_blob_id from kith-attach, documented with 'Rules mirror ...' comment. kith-chat does not depend on kith-attach, so the copy cannot be kept in sync automatically. kith-peer avoids this by calling kith_attach::BlobStore::validate_blob_id directly. Fix: add kith-attach as a dependency of kith-chat and replace the local copy with the canonical function. This is a single-authority security rule that should have a single implementation.
